title: 8.1.5 Lab: Round an Edge
description: Pick a single edge and smooth it with the Round tool. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Pick one edge, not a face
steps.instructions: You're starting from a 40 x 40 x 20 mm box. Move the mouse slowly onto the line where two faces meet: when the mouse is on an edge, the edge lights up light blue and a small label names it. Click while it is lit; it turns pink to show it is selected. You'll know it worked if the label above the Dimensions panel reads "Box 1 · edge".
hints: Look for the thin line along the top of the box where two faces meet. Slide the mouse across it until it lights up light blue, then click without moving. Pink means it is selected.
If the label reads "top face" instead of "edge", you clicked a little too far from the line. Try again, right on it.
Hard to see the edge? Drag in the 3D view to turn the box, or press Home to fit it.

steps.title: Round it to 3
steps.instructions: Press the Round tool in the toolbar. A new "Round 1" step appears in the timeline. In the Dimensions panel, type 3 in the radius field.
hints: If instead every edge of the box rounds at once, you selected the whole box rather than one edge — undo (Ctrl+Z) and try Step 1 again.
Look for the field named "Round 1 radius" in the Dimensions panel.

requirements.title: One edge rounded to 3 mm
requirements.description: The box has a single edge rounded to a 3 mm radius.
requirements.hint: Click exactly on one edge (the label should read "edge", not a face name), then press Round and type 3 in the radius field.
